desc:
Dive into Galactic Saga to explore different planets and exciting opportunities to forge a story unlike any other.

[NEW]
🎃 Halloween Event 2026: The Phantom Veil
👻 LIMITED Phantom Hunter pack, includes:
- 3 Limited Emotes
- Phantom Hilt
- Ethari form (Floating saber)

 🌍 Explore the vast planets of Corsucant, Korriban, Ilum, and Dromund Kaas.
 ⚔️ Master your skills with a Lightsaber
 👣 Choose your path: Jedi or Sith
 🪜 Climb through the Ranks
 💀 Dominate your enemies in Battle
 ✨ Harness your ability to use the Force!

 Become the most powerful master the Galaxy has ever seen!

🔔 Follow and Like for future Game Development!
